title.zh: 新專案提案與資源需求匯報

slide_title.zh: 執行摘要與核心訴求 (The Ask)

zh: 提案目標：啟動 [專案名稱]，以解決 [具體痛點] 並抓住市場機會
預期價值：預估可為公司節省 [X] 成本，或帶來 [X]% 的效能成長
核心訴求：申請 [具體金額/人力資源]，預計於 [時間段] 內完成驗收
en: Objective: Launch [Project Name] to solve [Pain Point] and capture market opportunity
Expected Value: Projected to save [X] in costs or drive a [X]% performance increase
The Ask: Requesting [Budget/Headcount], with expected delivery in [Timeframe]

speaker_notes.zh: 老闆好，今天提案的核心，是希望爭取一筆資源來啟動新專案。這個專案不僅能解決我們長期以來的痛點，更預期能在半年內為公司帶來具體的效能提升與成本節省。
speaker_notes.en: Good morning. The core of today's pitch is to secure resources to launch a new project. This initiative will not only solve our chronic pain points but is also projected to bring concrete efficiency gains and cost savings within six months.

slide_title.zh: 現狀痛點與隱含成本 (Current Pain Points)

zh: 現行流程缺陷：目前採用 [舊方法]，導致每個月浪費 [X] 小時人力
錯失的機會：因為缺乏 [新工具/新機制]，流失了潛在的成長動能
隱含風險：若維持現狀不作為，可能面臨 [合規風險 / 競爭力下降]
en: Process Flaws: Current reliance on [Old Method] wastes [X] man-hours monthly
Missed Opportunities: Lack of [New Tool/Mechanism] is draining growth momentum
Hidden Risks: Maintaining the status quo may lead to [Compliance Risks / Loss of Edge]

speaker_notes.zh: 我們為什麼現在必須做這件事？因為維持現狀的成本其實非常高。舊有流程不僅消耗大量無謂的人力，長遠來看甚至會產生潛在的合規與競爭力風險。
speaker_notes.en: Why must we act now? Because the cost of doing nothing is incredibly high. The legacy process consumes massive manual effort, and long-term, it exposes us to compliance and competitive risks.

slide_title.zh: 解決方案與具體行動 (Proposed Solution)

zh: 方案架構：導入 [新系統 / 新流程 / 新供應商]，從根本解決痛點
實施階段：分為 [規劃期]、[試行期]、[全面上線期] 三階段推進
優勢分析：相較於其他替代方案，此方案具備 [最高性價比 / 最快落地]
en: Solution Architecture: Implement [New System/Process/Vendor] to fix the root cause
Phased Rollout: Executed in 3 stages: [Planning], [Pilot], and [Full Launch]
Competitive Advantage: Compared to alternatives, this offers the [Best ROI / Fastest Time-to-Market]

speaker_notes.zh: 針對上述痛點，我們評估後提出這個解決方案。我們會採取分階段推行的策略，先在小範圍試行，確認成效後再全面展開，以將導入風險降到最低。
speaker_notes.en: To address these pain points, we propose this solution after thorough evaluation. We will use a phased rollout strategy, starting with a small-scale pilot to validate results before a full launch, thereby minimizing implementation risks.

slide_title.zh: 投資回報與效益評估 (ROI & Impact)

zh: 量化效益 (Quantitative)：預計上線後 [X] 個月內即可回本 (Break-even)
質化效益 (Qualitative)：大幅提升員工滿意度、強化資料安全性
成功指標 (Metrics)：將透過追蹤 [KPI 1] 與 [KPI 2] 來驗證專案成效
en: Quantitative Impact: Projected break-even within [X] months post-launch
Qualitative Impact: Significant boost in employee satisfaction and data security
Success Metrics: Project efficacy will be validated by tracking [KPI 1] and [KPI 2]

speaker_notes.zh: 從投資報酬率（ROI）來看，這個專案非常有價值。我們設定了明確的衡量指標，確保投入的每一分資源都能產生對應的商業效益。
speaker_notes.en: From an ROI perspective, this project is highly valuable. We have established clear metrics to ensure that every dollar invested generates a corresponding commercial return.

slide_title.zh: 資源需求、時程與風險控制 (Resource & Mitigation)

zh: 資源需求：需跨部門支援 [部門名稱] [X] 人月，以及預算 [金額]
關鍵時程：若本週獲准，將於 [日期] 啟動，[日期] 進行期中審查
風險管控：已識別 [潛在風險]，並備妥 [替代方案] 確保專案不中斷
en: Resource Requirements: Cross-functional support of [X] man-months from [Dept], plus [Budget]
Key Timeline: If approved this week, kickoff on [Date], mid-point review on [Date]
Risk Control: [Potential Risks] identified, with [Fallback Plans] ready to ensure continuity

speaker_notes.zh: 為了確保專案順利落地，除了上述預算，我們也需要跨部門的協助。我們已經做好了時程規劃與風險備案，只要今天取得授權，下週就能立刻啟動。
speaker_notes.en: To ensure smooth implementation, we need cross-departmental assistance in addition to the budget. We have our timelines and risk fallbacks prepared. With your authorization today, we can kick off next week.

prompt_template.zh: 請以繁體中文製作一份專業的『新專案提案與資源爭取 (Internal Pitch)』簡報。採用具說服力的商務提案風格。內容必須著重於：1. 痛點與不作為的隱含成本，2. 清晰的解決方案與投資報酬率 (ROI)，3. 明確的資源需求與風險管控措施。每張 Slide 不超過 3 個重點，每字不超過一行，語氣需自信、具備商業思維且強調具體效益。
prompt_template.en: Please create a professional 'New Project Proposal & Internal Pitch' presentation in English. Use a highly persuasive business pitch style. Focus on: 1. Pain points and the cost of inaction, 2. Clear solution and ROI, 3. Specific resource asks and risk mitigation. Max 3 bullet points per slide, max one line per bullet. Maintain a confident, commercially-minded tone emphasizing concrete impact.
